name: numenor

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --workspace apps/backend run dev" "npm --workspace apps/frontend run dev"
scripts.tunnel: npm run build && cross-env NUMENOR_TUNNEL=localtunnel node apps/backend/src/index.js
scripts.tunnel:cf: npm run build && cross-env NUMENOR_TUNNEL=cloudflared node apps/backend/src/index.js
scripts.tunnel:ngrok: npm run build && cross-env NUMENOR_TUNNEL=ngrok node apps/backend/src/index.js

description: Numenor - a local LaTeX writing workspace with AI help, live PDF preview and SyncTeX (based on OpenPrism)
